function.name: delete_sap_object
function.description: Delete an ENTIRE class or program. Permanent operation; a mandatory user confirmation popup is shown before deletion. To delete a METHOD from a class, do NOT use this tool - use modify_sap_object on the class instead (the method must be removed from both the section declaration and the implementation).

object_type.description: Only entire programs or classes can be deleted

object_name.description: Exact technical name of the object to delete. Never empty.

reason.description: Why the object is being deleted (shown in the confirmation popup)
